page.layout: Two columns of parallel Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: opening entry lines, a section letter heading, then entry lines. Right column: entry lines, a section letter heading, then entry lines ending with "Kal," at the lower right. Page number at top right. Running head at top of each column, in Hebrew letters.

main_text.head: עם
main_text.l: עם vel עם[?] populus, עמו[?] populo suo, עמי[?] populi, עמך[?] tui, No. f. m. praef. aff. & pl. m. aff. Rad. עמם[?] texit.
עמי[?] cum, עמו[?] à, עמי[?] mecum, עמך[?] tecum, עמו[?] cum eo, עמהם[?] ab eo, עמנו[?] nobiscum, &c. Part. Præp. præf. aff. Rad. עמם texit.
עמית[?] proximus, עמיתי[?] meus, עמיתו[?] ejus, No. f. m. aff. à Part. Præp. R. עמית secundum.
עמים[?] populis, עמם[?] populi, בעמיך[?] in populis tuis, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. עמם texit.
עמנו[?] nobiscum Deus, comp. ex Part. Præp.
cum, aff. עמם[?] nos, & Nomine Dei, אל[?] Deus, in Rad. אמץ[?] fortitudo.
עמים[?] emerentes, Neh. 4. 17. (pro עמסים[?]) Part. Ben. Kal. pl. m. Rad. עמם.
עמד[?] e regione, ex adverso ejus, לעמהם[?] illorum, & forma pl. f. ex adversa, Rad. Part. Præp. עמה[?] secundum, juxta, præf. & aff.
ענרם[?] annecte ea, Imper. Kal, sing. m. aff. Rad. ענה[?]
עמד[?] affige, canta, עמרה[?] cantare, affligere, לעמוך[?] ad affligendum te, עמר[?] affligere eum, Imper. Infin. Piel præf. aff. Rad. ענה.

page.notes: Heavy damage and show-through throughout, especially in the right column and the centre. Many Hebrew words are guessed from partial letters and are marked [?]; they should be checked against the scan. The faint letter above the centre of the right column, and the Hebrew letter heading after the first column, are read as section headings. The Hebrew of the top running head is partly obscured. The bottom of the right column is cut off: "prot" may be incomplete. Latin abbreviations are kept as printed.
